title: NDVI · Normalized difference vegetation index
summary: A ratio of near-infrared and red reflectance used to describe vegetation signals.
body: NDVI = (NIR − red) / (NIR + red). Clouds, season, irrigation and land cover influence the result. Crop marks may guide investigation but do not establish buried archaeology. Four dated 2025 Sentinel-2 mosaics are available on the Environmental evidence page, with cloud masks and acquisition dates. They provide context and do not change the terrain score.
